notes: Sheet 4H (Height and Bulk Districts, Lincoln Park / outer Richmond), the 2000 edition (sheet still dated June 1990). Double frame: an outer thin rule (~3 px) runs round the whole sheet, legend strip included, ~45 px outside an inner heavy rule (~9 px) on the left, top and right. The outline follows the inner heavy rule, the innermost rule (README rule 1); the thin outer rule and the paper between are outside. The bottom edge sits just above the thick top bar of the ruled-off legend and title strip (README rule 3: the strip is outside, with the district key, the planning-code note, the north arrow, the scale bar and the sheet number printed in it, so there is no remove polygon). Each side's inner edge was measured line by line from the scan (the longest dark run across the rule, its inner end), smoothed with a robust local-linear fit (+-300 px, residuals over 2.5 px dropped, so map ink running into a rule and 1 px nubs do not pull it), and the outline set 2 px inside the fit's 95th-percentile inner edge (README rule 1: the 1-bit rules are stair-stepped with 1 px nubs), points every ~200 px; corners where the fitted sides meet, then moved 2 px further in on both axes to clear the small rounded fillets inside the frame's corners. Measured paper between outline and rule: median 2-3 px, at most 5 px anywhere (README rule 8). The page is turned (~0.6 deg: left and right rules drift ~20-34 px right from top to bottom; the top rule and the legend bar rise ~30-43 px, y decreasing, from left to right). The heavy vertical line at x ~2850 is a printed map line with map on both sides: inside. 'SEE SHEET 3H' and 'SEE SHEET 5H' are cross-references without a ruled box: inside. No compass rose, legend block or SECTION badge inside the frame, so no remove polygon. No map ink touches the frame. Ink under the outline: one 1 px nub on the inner edge of the right rule at x ~3138, y ~1390-1440 (ink 1.0).
